 About the match
 On this page you can find the Buriram vs Kashima match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 4, on Wednesday 04-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Buriram lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Dougall, while Kashima sets up in a 4-4-2 led by Misao. Buriram is led by head coach Raúl Caneda, while Kashima is managed by Toru Oniki. The match is played at Chang Arena.
